author.name: Paresh Maharaj
author.shortBio: Adventurous, restless and South African. I travel solo when the road calls and with the family when the holidays do, and I write it all down so you can go too.

tagline: Slow roads and open skies: solo, with my wife, or with the whole family, from the Drakensberg to New York.

mediaKit.audience: Mostly South Africans aged 45–75 who plan, save for and take two or three trips a year — split between road trips at home and one bigger overseas journey.

newsletter.blurb: One honest letter a month: where I went, what it cost, and the padkos worth packing. No spam, unsubscribe any time.
